newsitem.title: CANADA: Ivaco to sell Georgia plant to Birmingham.
newsitem.headline: Ivaco to sell Georgia plant to Birmingham.

text.p: Ivaco Inc said it has signed a definitive agreement to sell its steelmaking plant in Cartersville, Georgia to Birmingham Steel Corp for C$100 million.

Ivaco said that in addition to the C$100 million it wiil receive a 15 percent interest in a newly created venture with Birmingham comprising Birminham's Jackson, Mississippi steelmaking and rolling unit as well as the facility in Cartersville.
The company said the deal is expected to close before the end of the year and is subject to regulatory approval.
